creative_improvements.idea: STALE_MAX_AGE_MINUTES = 30 — skip signals older than 30min at execution time
creative_improvements.rationale: 80 stale trades/7d at 48.8% WR vs 174 fresh at 54.0%. Stale PnL -$1.17 vs fresh +$1.14. ~$2.31/7d gap. Stale signals lose because market conditions change between detection and execution.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: +$1.5-2.5/7d (conservative — blocks 25% of trades but removes worst performers)
creative_improvements.risk: low — only affects old signals, fresh signals unaffected
creative_improvements.impact_on_winners: Need to verify — stale signals that won: 48.8% of 80 = 39 winners. Would block these. But fresh WR 54% is higher, so net gain expected.
